title: The coolest use for the Vision Pro
summary: An article exploring a particularly innovative and compelling use case for Apple's Vision Pro mixed reality headset, which garnered significant attention on Hacker News with 678 points and 262 comments from the tech community.
problem_solved: Demonstrates a practical and creative real-world application for expensive spatial computing hardware beyond typical demos.
why_valuable: Provides concrete evidence that Vision Pro can deliver genuinely useful experiences, countering skepticism about the device's practical value.
